scope: OUTSIDE OpenWorker coworker sidecar HTTP API: aisuite/** (providers, agents, mcp, framework, toolkits), aisuite-js/**, cli/py/aisuite-code-cli/**, examples/chat-ui/**, platform/surfaces/gui (non-HTML-iframe sinks, Tauri, file protocol), .github/workflows/**, viewer-ui/**. Skipped already-reported: chat-ui dotenv base_url cred theft; git config/diff filter/textconv/status filter-clean RCE; github pull hooks smudge; HTML artifact srcDoc XSS.

ruled_out.candidate: Re-report GitToolkit git_status/git_diff filter.clean/textconv/fsmonitor/diff.external
ruled_out.reason: Excluded by prompt / prior findings. _run still has no -c neutralization (aisuite/toolkits/git.py:65-73).

ruled_out.candidate: Re-report chat-ui load_dotenv(find_dotenv()) OPENAI_BASE_URL/AZURE_BASE_URL credential theft
ruled_out.reason: Already reported. Still at examples/chat-ui/chat.py:86-90. Notebook/example load_dotenv expansions are same class.

ruled_out.candidate: Re-report HTML artifact iframe sandbox allow-scripts+allow-same-origin
ruled_out.reason: Already reported CRITICAL (RightRail.tsx:366-370). Only iframe/srcDoc sink in GUI.

ruled_out.candidate: VIEWER_HTML escapeHtml ' breakout in onclick=selectRun (attribute entity decode XSS)
ruled_out.reason: Real pattern in fallback VIEWER_HTML (viewer.py:121-124,239) but packaged static React UI ships at aisuite/tracing/static/viewer (pyproject include) and is DEFAULT_UI_DIST. React viewer-ui uses text nodes / onClick handlers — no string-built onclick. Prior hunts correctly ruled this out as non-default.

ruled_out.candidate: Azure AZURE_API_VERSION CRLF HTTP header injection via urllib Request URL
ruled_out.reason: api_version is interpolated into the query string (azure_provider.py:97-98). Modern urllib raises InvalidURL on control characters; PoC against local server: request never sent.

ruled_out.candidate: GitToolkit inherits GIT_EXTERNAL_DIFF from process env (not .git/config)
ruled_out.reason: Plain `git diff` with only GIT_EXTERNAL_DIFF set does not invoke the helper (needs --ext-diff or diff.external). CLI/aisuite do not load workspace .env into the process.

ruled_out.candidate: ShellToolkit find -exec / interpreter prefix RCE under aisuite-code-cli
ruled_out.reason: run_shell has requires_approval=True; ApprovalController prompts. Distinct from OpenWorker auto-allow DEFAULT_ALLOWED_COMMANDS.

ruled_out.candidate: aisuite MCPClient stdio/HTTP from_config RCE/SSRF
ruled_out.reason: Caller-supplied intentional API; CLI does not load workspace MCP configs; httpx AsyncClient defaults follow_redirects=False.

ruled_out.candidate: Provider base_url / OLLAMA_API_URL / LMSTUDIO_API_URL / WATSONX_SERVICE_URL SSRF without untrusted env bridge
ruled_out.reason: Caller/env only. Extra env URL sinks via chat-ui dotenv are expansions of the already-reported chat-ui finding.

ruled_out.candidate: FileArtifactStore artifact_id ../ / absolute join traversal + viewer /api/artifacts
ruled_out.reason: Already flagged MEDIUM. Still unsanitized (_artifact_id / root / id) but needs data+metadata.json layout; viewer defaults 127.0.0.1.

ruled_out.candidate: viewer-ui fetchArtifact without encodeURIComponent + Load full artifact
ruled_out.reason: Same FileArtifactStore traversal class when user loads a crafted artifact_ref; not a distinct chain.

ruled_out.candidate: GUI artifact: basename/endsWith match opens unintended HTML
ruled_out.reason: RightRail.tsx:131 name/endsWith match amplifies HTML XSS UX but impact is the already-reported iframe chain.

ruled_out.candidate: kindFromPath treats .svg as image
ruled_out.reason: Server _artifact_kind/.list suffixes do not treat svg as image; read returns kind=text. No SVG-as-img XSS path.

ruled_out.candidate: Open in default app for .docm macros / .command RCE
ruled_out.reason: Open button only for sheet/pdf/office (RightRail.tsx:304). .command not listed as artifacts. Opening untrusted Office via OS is expected host behavior, not a complete in-app RCE chain comparable to srcDoc XSS.

ruled_out.candidate: PdfViewer innerHTML clear + pdf.js / SheetJS xlsx 0.18.5 prototype pollution → XSS
ruled_out.reason: innerHTML only cleared to ''; canvas append. sheet_to_json header:1 renders via React text (String(c)). No verified PP→XSS PoC on this call path.

ruled_out.candidate: Tauri CSP null / dangerous IPC / file:// navigation / w.eval
ruled_out.reason: Capabilities limited to pick_folder/autostart/keep-awake/dictation/updater. w.eval is fixed settings event string. Drop handlers preventDefault. CSP null only amplifies known iframe class.

ruled_out.candidate: Whisper model supply chain / updater integrity
ruled_out.reason: DEFAULT_MODEL_SHA256 verified; updater minisign pubkey in tauri.conf.json.

ruled_out.candidate: GHA secrets exposure / untrusted checkout RCE (release/pytest/black)
ruled_out.reason: No pull_request_target. Secrets only on tag/workflow_dispatch release builds; AuthKey.p8 under RUNNER_TEMP not uploaded; softprops draft. Unpinned actions on release already noted in prior reviews — no new secret-to-PR path.

ruled_out.candidate: aisuite-js prototype pollution / baseURL SSRF / chat-app XSS
ruled_out.reason: No recursive merge; baseURL only from explicit caller config; ApiKeyModal has no baseURL field; ChatMessage React text rendering.

ruled_out.candidate: PostgresStateStore SQLi / FileStateStore path traversal
ruled_out.reason: Parameterized queries; quote(thread_id, safe='').

ruled_out.candidate: pickle / yaml.load / eval / shell=True in aisuite package
ruled_out.reason: No matches; chat-ui uses yaml.safe_load; importlib only for ProviderFactory of known provider modules after get_supported_providers() check.

ruled_out.candidate: Markdown javascript: / rehype-raw XSS
ruled_out.reason: defaultUrlTransform + no rehype-raw; artifact: chip only.

examples/chat-ui + mcp_* + agents notebooks (dotenv class only)
poc_notes: Azure api_version CRLF: urllib.request.urlopen raises InvalidURL (control characters) — no wire request. GIT_EXTERNAL_DIFF env alone does not fire on plain git diff. Packaged viewer index.html present so VIEWER_HTML fallback not default.
